\begin{bookpage}{Patterns}
\pagesubtitle{Bass}
\begin{patternlist}
\patternitem{Root + fifth + octave}{\frets{R}~(same string), \frets{5}~(+2, next string), \frets{8}~(+2, two over)}{The default. Works under anything in the key.}
\patternitem{Major arpeggio}{\frets{R}~(same string), \frets{5}~(+2, next string), \frets{8}~(+2, two over), \frets{3}~(+1, three over)}{Major, maj7, 6.}
\patternitem{Minor arpeggio}{\frets{R}~(same string), \frets{5}~(+2, next string), \frets{8}~(+2, two over), \frets{3b}~(three over)}{Minor, m7, m6.}
\patternitem{Dominant seventh}{\frets{R}~(same string), \frets{5}~(+2, next string), \frets{7b}~(two over), \frets{3}~(+1, three over)}{Any 7 chord. The b7 pulls to the four.}
\patternitem{Minor seventh}{\frets{R}~(same string), \frets{5}~(+2, next string), \frets{7b}~(two over), \frets{3b}~(three over)}{The two and the six chord.}
\patternitem{Walking approach}{\frets{R}~(same string), \frets{5}~(+2, next string), \frets{6}~(+4, next string), \frets{7b}~(two over)}{Leading into the next chord.}
\end{patternlist}
\end{bookpage}
